title: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'thread[body]' parameter in…
description: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'thread[body]' parameter affecting all versions up to and including 3.2.4. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts. Exploitation is limited to forum viewers with custom access profiles that permit reading but deny attachment viewing, which is not the default configuration.
